includes: PhysioYoga classes include breathing, mindfulness, awareness, and mindful movement practices.
Dietitian services include initial assessment, education, resources, and follow-up sessions.
Psychology services include assessment, treatment planning, and evidence-based therapeutic modalities.
Physiotherapy-PhysioYoga includes assessment, treatment plan co-creation, and individualized exercises.
GLA:D program includes education sessions, neuromuscular exercises, and data collection for quality monitoring.
Custom bracing includes assessment and fitting of braces for sport injuries, arthritis, and post-operative support.
gap: Prices for all services not stated
blurb: Summit Physiotherapy + Wellness offers therapeutic group PhysioYoga classes led by physiotherapists and certified yoga therapists. They provide individualized dietitian services using evidence-based approaches to support nutrition goals. Their physiotherapy services include assessments, treatments, and specialized programs such as male pelvic health and the GLA:D Canada program for osteoarthritis.
extraNote: Work-related injuries covered by Workers’ Compensation Board; claim info required. · Motor vehicle accident injuries accepted; claim info required; no doctor referral needed. · Rarely accept walk-ins; appointments recommended. · Direct billing available for some extended health insurance plans; check with provider.
